verdict.rationale: mise documents a dedicated lockfile mechanism: "commit a lockfile and run `mise install --locked`" for reproducible installs, backed by checksum/signature/provenance verification (Cosign/Minisign, SLSA, GitHub attestations) to ensure the exact same resolved artifacts are installed everywhere. Community evidence corroborates mise's general reproducibility/version-pinning strengths across teams, though not the lockfile flag specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that `--locked` produces bit-identical resolved versions across machines, and more detail on lockfile format/edge cases.
